adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed `safeParse` (handleAdd) but is never reset on successful validation or in the mutation `onSuccess`. `onSuccess` only does `setIsOpenDialog(false)` and `setMultiEmailValue([""])`, so because the component remains mounted (it’s always rendered in `BookingListItem` and only `open` toggles), reopening the dialog can show the error block (`{isInvalidEmail && ...}`) even with a fresh/empty form. The Cancel button clears it, but success path does not.
